note: Raw numbers behind §10 of docs/design/recall-evaluation.md. All runs isolated to a scratch HOME (see README.md). Times are wall-clock; deja and claudemem built from source with the repo toolchain, remem taken from its published checksummed release.

environment.rust: not installed on host; remem run from its prebuilt binary

install.runtime_deps: none (single binary; sqlite3 only for Cursor IDE chats)

queries.questions_file: see measurements per-question in the parent doc §10 notes

session_start_digest.fence: <deja-recall> ... </deja-recall> with an explicit "untrusted reference data" preamble

redaction.note: catches AIza- and lin_api_-shaped values that recall misses; the 4 misses are searchable in the index (leaked at ingest)

hookyard_fit.exec_wrapper: feasible; hook-context/hook-prompt print plain text a ~15-line wrapper re-emits as additionalContext (same shape as recall's wrapper)
hookyard_fit.demands_own_hooks_or_mcp: no — ships both hooks and an MCP server, but the CLI digest is self-contained

install.db: SQLCipher-encrypted scratch ~/.remem/remem.db, schema v93, 1.68 MB on create

model_dependency.mechanism: crate::ai::call_ai spawns the host claude/codex CLI (src/ai/cli.rs, src/ai/codex_cli.rs)
model_dependency.architecture: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3: SessionRollup -> 'AI -> semantic summary'; ObservationExtract -> 'AI -> structured observations'
model_dependency.decision: per the isolation rule, no model/API key was configured; curated-memory quality was NOT evaluated

offline_raw_path.capture: Stop payload -> remem summarize --host claude-code -> remem worker --once drained 154 messages from repo-a in ~1 s (inserted=154 parse_errors=0), then failed at the AI stage
offline_raw_path.curated_search: empty (no candidates distilled without the model); search falls back to raw archive

redaction.note: the raw archive stored every fake secret verbatim; redaction code exists in the LLM/distillation path, which was not exercised (no model)

engine_coverage.codex: native (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, Stop; PostToolUse intentionally unsupported)

hookyard_fit.exec_wrapper: possible for context only; capture needs remem's own hooks
hookyard_fit.demands_own_hooks_or_mcp: yes — install writes .claude/settings.json hooks and MCP config; core job needs an LLM CLI

install.store: markdown files + regenerable SQLite FTS5/vector cache under scratch ~/.claudemem

claudemem.shape: durable notes + agent-authored session reports, not a transcript indexer — it cannot replay existing transcripts

redaction.note_add_session_save: none — the 17 fake secrets were written verbatim into the markdown source of truth
redaction.hook_event: the non-mutating `hook event` candidate classifier does redact text; it never writes

hookyard_fit.demands_own_hooks_or_mcp: no MCP; capture is agent/skill driven (notes and session reports must be authored)

claudemem.overlap: overlaps §4's durable-facts store far more than the session-continuity half

port-our-own.estimated_go_lines: ~400-600 including Claude/Codex/Pi transcript parsers, git invocation and digest rendering
